source_refs.note: Time period and frequency: a main subheading of 14.3 Practical S.H.M Systems, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 22-23.

blocks.text: S.H.M ki aam equation a = −ω²x hai (aage Eq. 14.8). Isay a = −(k/m)x se milayein to:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri line T = 2π√(k/m) chhapi hai. Sahi T = 2π√(m/k) hai, kyun ke T, f = (1/2π)√(k/m) ka ulat (reciprocal) hai, is liye root ke andar m/k aata hai. Matlab: mass bhari ho to period lamba; spring sakht (k bara) ho to period chhota.

blocks.title: Point to ponder!
blocks.text:
S.H.M ka principle (usool) asal zindagi mein yahan kaam aata hai:
• Pendulum wali ghariyan (clocks), musical instruments aur gariyon ka suspension system waghera.

blocks.title: Example 14.1
blocks.problem: S.H.M karne wale ek particle (zarra) ki angular frequency 2 rad s⁻¹ hai. Is ki frequency aur time period nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: ω = 2 rad s⁻¹. Maloom karna hai: f = ? aur T = ?
Dono taraf 2 se divide (taqseem) karein: f = 1/π ≈ 1/3.14 ≈ 0.318 Hz
blocks.answer: Frequency taqreeban 0.318 Hz aur time period taqreeban 3.14 s (kitab ise 'taqreeban 3 seconds' likhti hai).

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Dutch mathematician, astronomer aur physicist Christiaan Huygens ne 1656 mein pehli pendulum clock (pendulum wali ghari) patent karayi. Unhon ne simple harmonic motion ki madad se pendulum ki lambai aur waqt ka formula pakka kiya.

blocks.alt: Huygens ki pehli pendulum clock (1656) lakri ke lambe case mein: oopar Roman numbers wala dial aur gears, neeche pendulum ki rod aur gol bob. Baen bar par screws b, a, c; screw a ka coil spring pendulum ke oopar jura hai, screw c ke saath chhota spring aur mass m, jis ki line rod ke ring se B ki taraf jati hai. Teer rod ke dono taraf faasla x aur direction A dikhate hain. Baen taraf driving weight (chalane wala wazan) latka hai.
blocks.caption: Huygens' First Pendulum Clock (1656): Huygens ki pehli pendulum clock (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
